_readme: The short list of HALA MOVE values that must not be wrong when an asset or a message is produced. Public on purpose, no key needed. Fetch it, read it, quote it. Every value says where it came from and when, in _provenance. A value is either DERIVED from the file that declares it, PROBED from the live store, or ATTESTED by a person with an expiry date. If a value here disagrees with a slide, a flyer, a page or an older document, THIS IS THE ONE.

_trust.derived_values: re-derived from source and compared on every push (backend: node scripts/brand-manifest/check.js). A mismatch fails loud and names the value.
_trust.probed_values: asked of the live store, with an invalid-subject control that must fail. Re-confirm within 14 days; after that the sensor calls them stale.
_trust.attested_values: no machine source exists, so a person confirmed them. Re-confirm within 90 days.
_trust.scope: This file carries only what is already public in effect: what we are called, where the apps are, what we may and may not say, and who we are. Anything commercially sensitive is deliberately kept off it — ask Eric or Uchenna for that.

wordmark.rule: Two spans: "HALA" in brand green, "MOVE" in white, Outfit Black 900. Rendered output always reads "HALA MOVE" in full.

links.routing: One link per app. iPhone is sent to the App Store, everything else to Google Play. Safe to print — the destination can be re-pointed without reprinting.
links.campaign_tag: Append ?s=<code> (letters, numbers, _ or -, max 32) to either link. It survives as an Apple campaign token on iPhone and a Google Play install referrer on Android.

pioneer.public_line: Pioneer Program: the first 500 drivers are charged zero commission on their first 20 completed jobs — they keep 100%.

referral.public_line: When their first move completes, you BOTH earn R50 — the referrer and the referred person each get the reward. T&Cs apply.

commission.public_line: Keep up to 80% of every job. Pioneer drivers currently keep 100%.

customer: Verified drivers send offers — you choose the price
Bakkies, panel vans and trucks — from a small bakkie to a 4-ton truck
Escrow-protected payments (PayFast), released only after delivery / when your delivery is confirmed
You get a suggested fair price
Every move saved in your in-app history
driver: Turn your bakkie, van or truck into income
Set your price on every job
Same-day payout for jobs completed before 5pm
Cash out to your bank whenever you want (min R50, 2–3 business days)
Pioneer Program — zero commission for the first 500 drivers on their first 20 completed jobs (they keep 100%)
Go online, see jobs near you
trust: Identity-verified drivers: SA ID checked against the government database, selfie face-match, licence, vehicle registration, roadworthy certificate, bank account — typically within 24 hours
Every item photographed before loading and at delivery — timestamped. No he-said-she-said.
Disputes reviewed with a finding within 24 hours
One-tap SOS on every active job
positioning: Earn on your schedule. Own your route.
A bakkie, van or truck can't drive for Uber or Bolt — those move people. HALA MOVE is the only way that vehicle earns on demand.
coverage: Live in Durban — CBD, Umhlanga, Umlazi, Pinetown, Westville and the metro — plus inter-city trips across KwaZulu-Natal. Johannesburg and Cape Town next.
b2b: Fleet contracts from R5,000/month (typical range R15,000–R200,000/month) · contract setup in 24 hours · complaint response within 2 business hours

not_yet.say_instead: Escrow-protected payments. Every item photographed before loading and at delivery, timestamped. Disputes reviewed with a finding within 24 hours.
HALA MOVE makes no guarantee of income. Quote the Pioneer commission terms instead.

not_yet.do_not_say: A percentage discount on a first move
not_yet.say_instead: There is no discount mechanism. The referral reward is the only credit rail.
Numbers are sent to creators weekly.

not_yet.do_not_say: Any INVENTED driver count, download count, rating or review count, or "on the platform" / "ready and waiting" phrasing
not_yet.say_instead: The one approved figure is "200+ drivers committed before the app launched" — committed, not onboarded. Any other number comes from Eric on the day it is posted, or it is not posted. No public counter exists.

not_yet.do_not_say: HALA MOVE operates outside Durban / KwaZulu-Natal
not_yet.say_instead: Live in Durban and the wider KwaZulu-Natal region.

company.operating_area: Durban and the wider KwaZulu-Natal region, South Africa
